evidence.title: Compile your design system into an Agent Plugin
GitHub - Railly/tinte: Compile your design system into an Agent Plugin.

name: Tinte
summary: CLI that compiles a site's design system into an agent plugin and editor themes.
description: Tinte extracts computed styles from a live page into thirteen semantic OKLCH tokens, compiles them into an installable Agent Plugin (SKILL.md + tokens.css) for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor, and emits themes for editors and terminals from one config. A linter fails the build on colors that bypass the tokens.
contains: extracts computed styles into 13 semantic OKLCH tokens
theme targets: VS Code/Cursor, Zed, Kitty, Warp, Alacritty, Windows Terminal, Slack, GIMP, Shiki
themes installable as shadcn registry items
